SealedIssueResolution.title: SealedIssueResolution
SealedIssueResolution.description: The sealed issue-resolution record: immutable content plus its SHA-256 content digest (exact-revision addressing).

IssueResolutionId.title: IssueResolutionId
IssueResolutionId.description: Opaque issue-resolution record identity: "issue-resolution:" followed by a lowercase slug.

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

SolutionId.title: SolutionId
SolutionId.description: Opaque solution-package identity: "solution:" followed by a lowercase slug (stable across versions).

IssueRecordId.title: IssueRecordId
IssueRecordId.description: Opaque execution-issue record identity: one of the five family prefixes followed by a lowercase slug.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 identity grammar).

FieldEvidenceLink.title: FieldEvidenceLink
FieldEvidenceLink.description: One field-evidence reference: the W006 evidence record digest (photo, sensor reading, or document) plus capture context — captured instant and principal, optional opaque capture method and note. NEVER an embedded payload.

OpaqueReference.title: OpaqueReference
OpaqueReference.description: Opaque, bounded, provider-neutral reference string owned by its producing system.
